content_of_post_to_comment:
I know I'm asking on the nosurf subreddit but the people I want to ask about most probably wouldn't be able to read my question.

Asking "at home" because maybe it is nearly impossible to live without internet since some burocratic things need to be done only online, but I understand they could be done on a computer at the library.
comment: You don't necessarily have to choose between being completely offline and having constant internet access. A computer at the library could handle the unavoidable bureaucratic stuff, while keeping your home free from internet might make it easier to break the habit. The tricky part is figuring out which tasks genuinely require being online and which have just become convenient to do that way.
